title: Google Ads in Europe 2025: Strategies That Actually Drive Conversions

facts.fact: The article claims that by 2025, more than 70% of Google searches in Europe are conducted on mobile devices; no source is cited for this figure.
facts.quote: By 2025, more than 70% of Google searches in Europe are conducted on mobile devices.

facts.fact: The article states that privacy laws such as GDPR continue to shape how advertisers collect and use data in Europe.
facts.quote: Privacy laws such as GDPR continue to shape how advertisers collect and use data, while AI-driven automation has redefined how campaigns are built and optimized.

facts.fact: The article says that with third-party cookies nearly extinct, brands must rely on first-party data and privacy-safe audience targeting.
facts.quote: With third-party cookies nearly extinct, brands must rely on**first-party data**and privacy-safe audience targeting.
